zh.title: Epic E1000 AX 的 Garmin 緊急自動降落系統取得 FAA 認證
zh.summary: Epic Aircraft 宣布 E1000 AX 可安裝已獲 FAA 認證的 Garmin Autoland，供飛行員失能時使用。
body: Epic Aircraft 於 2026 年 9 月 30 日宣布，美國 FAA 已認證 E1000 AX 的 Garmin Autoland 系統，准許在這款單引擎渦槳機上安裝。
當飛行員無法繼續操控時，乘客可按專用按鈕啟動系統，系統也可自行判斷並介入。它會評估機場、跑道、燃油、地形與天氣，選擇降落地點，並自動與航管通訊、完成降落及關閉引擎。
Autoland 整合於 Garmin G1000 NXi 航電，並與管理引擎動力的 Autothrottle 協同運作。此次公告為特定機型系統認證，未提供已安裝航機數量。

en.title: FAA certifies Garmin Autoland for Epic E1000 AX
en.summary: Epic Aircraft says the emergency landing system is cleared for installation on its single-engine turboprop.
body: Epic Aircraft announced on September 30, 2026 that the FAA had certified Garmin Autoland for the E1000 AX, clearing the system for installation.

Passengers can activate Autoland with a dedicated button if the pilot cannot fly, or the system can intervene automatically. It evaluates airports, runways, fuel, terrain and weather, then communicates with air traffic control, lands and shuts down the engine.

Autoland is integrated with Garmin G1000 NXi avionics and works with Autothrottle to manage engine power. The announcement concerns certification and did not state how many aircraft already have the system installed.

facts.claim: FAA certified Garmin Autoland for E1000 AX, announced 2026-09-30, cleared for installation.
Manual and automatic activation; airport selection, ATC communication, landing and engine shutdown.
Integrated with Garmin G1000 NXi and Autothrottle.
